title: Personal business cards: still printed, or only the three team cards?
detail: For the stand-up at 12:00 today: Angelo moved it from 13:00 (5 Nov, relayed by Vicky); this folder keeps the 13:00 id until data/meetings/schedule.json changes. Dinis ordered 600 team cards with no names (gold, green, blue; WS-155, collection Fri 6 Nov). The garment printer's brief still lists 700 personal cards, 100 per person with each person's name and own QR (/print-order/, /print/#next), and /procurement/ says personal cards are 'not started'. Vicky gave her card content (Vicky Wang, Project Manager) and voted R2-6 for a personal card. Vicky, 5 Nov about 10:00 UTC: "I'll go with whatever Dinis decides on personal cards."
recommend: Team cards only for the summit: they are ordered and final; tell the garment printer the cards are not part of its order, so nobody pays for or signs 700 cards that won't be used. Personal cards after Lisbon if wanted.
options: Team cards only: drop the personal cards from the garment printer's order and from /print/
Both: team cards for handing out, plus a short personal run (e.g. 50 each) in the chosen personal design
Personal cards later, after the summit, if the team cards run out

decided.said: present team members are ok with generic business cards (Angelo's notes of the 12:00, 5 November; present: Angelo, Jose, Silvio, Vicky; Dinis, Nimay and Indi were not there, so this is for those present: the three team cards only)
